description.narrative: The overall goal of the project is to contribute to a sustainable socially just energy transition in Vietnam. The specific objective is to increase public and private-sector awareness of renewable energy (RE) and energy efficiency (EE) policies/programmes, and toensure that the effectiveness of RE/EE practices and initiatives are significantly raised, contributing to sustainable energy supply, consumption and security in Vietnam, the country’s transition towards a low-carbon economy and increased gendersensitivity in theenergy sector. The project has four key priorities: i) to equip key public and private stakeholders with understanding and knowledge of RE/EE policies, the effectiveness of RE/EE measures and initiatives; ii) to improve media communication and coverage on RE/EE and gender sensitivity in the energy sector; iii) to increase gender sensitive RE/EE practices in the daily life and businesses; iv) to increase the number of businesses accessing to investment for RE/EE practices. Gender sensitivity is integrated throughout the Action, ensuring that it not only contributes to Vietnam’s sustainable energy targets but also ensures a gender equitable and sociallyjust energy transition. The project was developed and implemented by a coalition of3partners Oxfam, VCCI, and the Vietnam Journalism Association. In this project, Vietnam Chamber of Commerce and Industry (VCCI) joins the Action as a co-applicant with Oxfam. VCCI is the largest business membership organization in Vietnam. It has a verywide network of member businesses in all sectors and nationwide. Importantly, VCCI is a very influential and advisory organization to the Government of Vietnam in terms of business. Participating in the Action as a co-applicant will allow VCCI to make the best use of its expertise, network, and influence on both businesses and the Government. VCCI will be mainly responsible for coordinating the work of building the network of SMEs and banks, raising awareness and support for gender sensitive RE/EE practices;it will also broker dialogue between SMEs, banks and policy makers. VCCI will work on both national and provincial levels with business associations in each province.
